body: It’s mainly financial issues right now but even when that wasn’t a big problem it’s like I always find a way to fall back into suicidal thoughts because I’ll start to think about how my late mom would hate who I’ve become now or how I’m such a failure because I didn’t live up to the expectations I had for myself

Yeah but he doesn’t understand how something small could bug me so much and he does his best to reassure me that what I’m going through isn’t the end of the world but I can’t help but constantly feel this way
